bio: This part of the Mandarin Oriental's culinary portfolio serves food all day. In addition to lunch and dinner, you can have breakfast and afternoon tea here – all in tasteful surroundings that combine a stylish, old-world feel with a brasserie atmosphere. The menu features international cuisine including classics like Angus beef tartare and raclette cheese burger, as well as Asian bar snacks such as crispy duck rolls. The bar serves an excellent assortment of drinks. Tip: Drop in at the Grand Casino next door....
